Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the [Gatefront Ruins Hidden Cellar](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164084).  

**Utility:** Used to add or replace Skills and Affinities on weapons and shields.

Locations.Title: Iron Whetblade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the cellar guarded by the [Imp Seal Statue](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164744).  
**Utility:** Used to add the following Affinities to *any* Ash of War:
- Heavy: Increases STR scaling, decreases all other scalings.
- Keen: Increases DEX scaling, decreases all other scalings.
- Quality: Balances STR and DEX scalings, decreases base damage.

Locations.Title: Glintstone Whetblade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In a small room, up in on the balcony.  
**Utility:** Used to add the following Affinities to physical and magic Ashes of War:
- Magic: Increases INT scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds magic damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Magic defense, decreases all other defenses.
- Cold: Increases INT scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds magic damage, reduces base damage. Grants Frostbite buildup while attacking.

Locations.Title: Red-Hot Whetblade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the tower, guarded by an Iron Maiden.  
**Utility:** Used to add the following Affinities to physical and flame Ashes of War:
- Fire: Decreases all scalings. Adds fire damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Fire defense, decreases all other defenses. Changes fire damage scaling to STR instead of FAI.
- Flame Art: Increases FAI scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds fire damage, reduces base damage.

Locations.Title: Sanctified Whetblade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the manor, in the first floor's south wing. On a corpse past a broken wall.  
**Utility:** Used to add the following Affinities to physical and golden Ashes of War:
- Sacred: Increases FAI scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds Holy damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Holy defense, decreses all other defenses.
- Lightning: Increases DEX scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds Lightning damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Lightning defense, decreses all other defenses.

Locations.Title: Black Whetblade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In front of the altar, on a corpse.  
**Utility:** Used to add the following Affinities to physical and occult Ashes of War:
- Poison: Increases STR, DEX and ARC scaling. Grants Poison buildup while attacking.
- Blood: Increases ARC scaling, decreases all other scalings. Grants Bleed buildup while attacking, or empowers an existing Bleed effect, scaling with ARC.
- Occult: Increases ARC scaling, decreases all other scalings.

Locations.Title: Extreme Repentance
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Given by [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164504) under the following conditions:

1. Befriend him by sparing his life during the first encounter. Let the fight end completely. Doing so will reward you with [Grovel for Mercy](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165136).
2. Reinitiate the fight by attacking him a few times.
3. Let Patches attack you until your HP drops low enough (approximately below 50%). He will then offer to accept your surrender, automatically granting you **Extreme Repentance**.
4. Perform the newly obtained gesture while your HP is still low to make Patches stop attacking and become friendly again.

**Note:** Performing Grovel for Mercy is not required to obtain Extreme Repentance, as the gesture is awarded automatically when Patches offers you the chance to surrender.

Locations.Title: Finger Reader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Next to the collapsed bridge connecting Limgrave and Liurnia.

Tells the Tarnished about the two crescent halves—[Dectus Medallion (Left)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164496) and [Dectus Medallion (Right)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166653)—that they must bring together at the [Grand Lift of Dectus](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164180).

_Head to the foundation of gold, Tarnished...  
Traverse Raya Lucaria; "Glintstone Eventide"...  
...and reunite the half crescents, at the Grand Lift.  
Oh, but the bridge is collapsed, and cannot be crossed.  
Only, why should that matter!  
Stormveil Castle still stands tall!_

Locations.Title: Finger Reader Crone
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Informs you of the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle and of Millicent.

"...Are you one for festivals? Or flowers?
To the South, a grand festival to make the stars turn.  
To the East, the hardened bud of a flower to be.  
But dare you enter?
Into the heart of the scarlet rot?"

Locations.Title: Finger Reader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
"Slaughter, slaughter, slaughter... The all-hearing slaughtered, but alas, it was for naught.

But all you need do, is snatch it from the big pot.Pity the poor, poor fool!".

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** On the wooden bridge before Elemer of the Briar.

Appears here after defeating [Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167571). Will give you the  [Dancer's Castanets](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175929) after speaking with him.

**Quest:** [Patches' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166248)

Locations.Title: Patches (4th Location)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the entrance corridor of the manor, before the room with Tanith.

Appears here after you join the Volcano Manor (unrelated to falling in his trap on Mt. Gelmir)

**Quest:** [Patches' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166248)

Locations.Title: Rya (2nd Location - Alternate)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
She will be there if you gave her the necklace from Blackguard at Liurnia of the lakes. Teleports you to Volcano Manor if you take her hands.

Only appears here if you arrive through [Ruin-Strewn Precipice](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165513) rather than the [Grand Lift of Dectus](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164180)

**Quest:** [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

Locations.Title: Hyetta (5th location)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** At the very bottom of the [Subterranean Shunning Grounds](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175442).  Get to the [Frenzied Flame Proscription](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=168677) Site of Grace, then open the secret passage and descend the depths.   

**Quest:** [Hyetta's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169804)

Locations.Title: Rya (3rd location)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Down the hall from [Tanith](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167573), inside the room through the second door on the right.  

**Quest:** [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Quest:** [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:

**Quest:** [Brother Corhyn's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=178950).

Reload the area, then visit it again to loot [Goldmask Armor Set](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=177442).

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Roundtable Hold](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165686) - Near [Gideon Ofnir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169061).  
**Note:** After receiving either [Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167191) or [Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167291), he will turn into [an invader](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167506).

Locations.Title: Diallos (4th Location)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In one of the houses, tending to a jar  
**Quest:**  [Diallos' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167784)

Locations.Title: Melina
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Appears after resting at a Site of Grace once you've discovered three of them.

Locations.Title: Needle Knight Leda (First Meeting)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Needle Knight Leda will be the first person you see before jumping into the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.

You can find her at the Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum in the Lands Between, which is located in the underground section of the map beneath Caelid.

Locations.Title: Noble Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Castle Morne](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163951) - in a cage in the cell behind the castle

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"The demi-humans wax wroth, now their mother's been taken..._

_Where are you, Lord Kenneth?_

_The knight... bedeviled by blood."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Speak to him and receive a hint about the [Tower of Return](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163981)

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting on the edge of the cliff by the [Rotview Balcony](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164372) Site of Grace.

_It's rotting. Everything, rotting scarlet. The very earth that Caelid rests upon, and Sellia, town of Sorcery. The end is nigh, for us all._

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the left as you enter the lift chamber

_"...It's there, somewhere. Another path, leading back to the foot of the Erdtree. An ancient tunnel."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Ghost just beyond the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace.

"Ahh, the puppets..." "The puppets besiege us..."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"Ahh, Lord Vyke, it seems that you were no lord, after all."_

_"Then where is he? Our true Lord, our Lord of Frenzied Flame."_

_"We beg of you, incinerate all that divides and distinguishes."_

_"Ahh, may chaos take the world!"_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting on a small rock outside the ruin

_"Come out, one and all, from the darkness underground."_
_"And let us offer unto the maiden our eyes."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting outside the [Church of Pilgrimage](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163994)

"*The mausoleum prowls. Cradling the soulless demigod.*

*O Marika, Queen Eternal. He is your unwanted child.*"

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the [Nokron, Eternal City](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167493) area.

Watch out - you may be ambushed while listening to it.

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: "Let me see it, if only one last time. Your splendid blade, dancing amongst the scarlet rot"

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found sitting on the floor of the East side of Kingsrealm Ruins.

" Ah, Iji, forgive me. These royal grounds were placed in our trust, but we stood no chance.:

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"I'm dry, dry as a bone..._

_Foul dragon, surrender your strength._

_Let me feast on your heart."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Near the edge of the rock, gazing at the minor erdtree.

_"O Sapling! Sweet sapling of glorious gold. Has your crystal teardrop ripened?"_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"..."_

"_Ahh_, _the poor fellow_..._gone perfectly mad_."

"_Love_..._revenge_..._the frenzied flame melts it all away_..."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"Raya Lucaria, hallowed hall dedicated to the study of magic."_

_"Why shut your doors to me? Am I barred from donning the crown of stone?"_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
"Maiden, dear maiden, where are you?
Please, take my grapes."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the small cliff, facing the erdtree.

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the Church of the Eclipse

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Just beyond the Site of Grace in the Windmill Village, amongst a broken wagon.

" Eek... I hear a festive melody... No, no, don't skin me... My hide is filthy, I swear."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Lying in front of the fire

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Next to the entrance in the study hall.

_"O Celestial Globe, transmit to posterity. The wisdom of the moon and stars. And obscure, forever, the transgressions of the princess."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Add the edge of the cliff.
"...
Sublime, I tell you. 
The very first flower of Aeonia bloomed on this very spot.
Malenia, may you blossom into a goddess."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting inside **Caria Manor**'s southwest room, under **Manor Lower Level** site of grace.

"Lady Ranni, we have long awaited you. I pray for your house's swift revival. May the full moon shine upon Caria."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting on a stone, facing north. Just east of the Guide Statue.

...

Only ... a little further now...

Show met the path, O gentle lights ... the path to Elphael.

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Outside Deathtouched Catacombs.

"Unthinkable. Our hollowed resting place is violated. To refuse the Erdtree's call to return, to live within Death... Sickening."

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_"Mohg, you rotten Omen. Your blood is cursed.
 Give him back.
Give Lord Miquella back!
How dare you lay hands on such precious flesh."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Fort Gael](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164412) - After entering the castle through the backladder, cross the wooden beam, on the wall looking over Caelid.

_"Convene the festival of war. Honor General Radahn, with a warrior's glory. It's in your hands, Sir Jerren."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Stormfoot Catacombs, at the entrance, just in front of the site of grace.

_A proper death means returning to the Erdtree. Have patience. Until the time comes...and the roots call to you._

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: _Heh heh... I'll survive, I swear it. I'll soon be back at Volcano Manor._

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sitting near a well at the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace.

_"This village is done for. Please, even if it's just you, old Albus, hide well and still your breath."_

Locations.Title: Ghost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Sitting in a chair overlooking the Cave of Knowledge.

Locations.Title: Oridys's Rise Puzzle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Interact with the pedestal in front of [Oridys's Rise](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163958) to begin the puzzle to unlock the barrier.

**Clue:** Seek 3 wise beasts

**Solution:** You need to find and kill the three ghostly tortoises:

1. Found on the path leading up to the tower. To the north of the pedestal.
2. Found in the bushes behind the pedestal (to the left of the staircase)
3. Found in a small pond behind the tower.  This tortoise won't be visible, instead you'll need to watch for splashes in the water to find it's location.

Locations.Title: Testu's Rise Puzzle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Interact with the pedestal in front of Testu's Rise to begin the puzzle to unlock the barrier.

**Clue:** Seek 3 wise beasts

**Solution:** You need to find and kill the three ghostly tortoises:

1. Found to the left of the stairs
2. Found behind the tower, on a tree
3. Found to the right of the tower, below

Locations.Title: Converted Fringe Tower Puzzle
